title: P34: proposal-list entries must be PublicMessage proposals
description: protocol-06 §5.3 HandshakeBundle.moreProposals and §5.5 FanoutMessage externalProposals are commented as 'additional proposals ... as either PublicMessage or SemiPrivateMessage' but the content type is not constrained in the syntax. Readings: (a) any MLSMessage; (b) only proposal content. Chosen: (b), entries must be PublicMessages with content_type proposal (SemiPrivateMessage deferred, mimid-1wgh.4.12); others rejected on decode and encode.
